description:
Ranks foods by how much of one nutrient they carry per 100 g.

Per-100 g ranking favors foods eaten in small amounts, such as spices and
dried herbs; the category filter narrows the list to one food group.
Results are paged, and pagination.next_offset is null on the last page.

category.description: USDA food category, matched as a substring, e.g. Vegetables or Legumes.

data_type.description: One USDA dataset. Foundation and SR Legacy are unbranded whole foods, Branded is packaged products, and Survey (FNDDS) is prepared dishes. Omitted, all four are searched.

offset.description: Results to skip, from pagination.next_offset. Defaults to 0.

name: find_foods_by_nutrient
title: Rank foods by nutrient
